# Vendored Agent Skills

Third-party Agent Skill snapshots are stored in [agent-skills/](agent-skills/), separate from the project-authored [tools/skills/](../skills/).

They are not automatically installed and are not runtime dependencies of the evidence exporter or website. Before installing or redistributing a skill, review its metadata, executable instructions, scripts, and license.

See the [provenance summary](agent-skills/PROVENANCE.md), [machine-readable mapping](agent-skills/provenance.json), and [third-party notices](../../THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md).
